name: Tube Archivist
description: YouTube channel and playlist archiving tool with a searchable web library.

envVars.description: Password for the bundled Elasticsearch instance

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      REDIS_CON: "redis://{{serviceName}}-redis:6379"
      ES_URL: "http://{{serviceName}}-es:9200"
      TA_USERNAME: {{env.TA_USERNAME}}
      TA_PASSWORD: {{env.TA_PASSWORD}}
      ELASTIC_PASSWORD: {{env.ELASTIC_PASSWORD}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/youtube:/youtube
      - {{appDataPath}}/cache:/cache
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-es:
    image: bbilly1/tubearchivist-es:latest
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-es
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      ELASTIC_PASSWORD: {{env.ELASTIC_PASSWORD}}
      ES_JAVA_OPTS: "-Xms1g -Xmx1g"
      discovery.type: single-node
